profiles.name: Wetrom Bahanda
profiles.description: Wetrom Bahanda represents Kota Marudu, Sabah, in the Dewan Rakyat. Affiliated with KDM.
profiles.affiliation_note: Parliament lists KDM and the August report identifies Wetrom as its deputy president. Speculation about joining BN is not recorded as a move. KDM’s withdrawal concerned Sabah’s state government; it is not treated as a federal withdrawal.

profiles.name: Isnaraissah Munirah Majilis
profiles.description: Isnaraissah Munirah Majilis represents Kota Belud, Sabah, in the Dewan Rakyat. Affiliated with WARISAN.

profiles.name: Madius Tangau
profiles.description: Madius Tangau represents Tuaran, Sabah, in the Dewan Rakyat. Affiliated with UPKO.
profiles.affiliation_note: The 18 June 2026 admission of UPKO into GRS supersedes its earlier PH alignment. Former leadership titles are not presented as current.

party_parents_added.name: Parti Kesejahteraan Demokratik Masyarakat
party_parents_added.description: A separate Sabah-based party supporting the federal government. Its August 2026 withdrawal concerned the GRS-led Sabah state government; it is not listed here as a GRS component.

party_parents_added.name: Parti Warisan
party_parents_added.description: A Sabah-based party supporting the federal Unity Government. Its state-level opposition role is separate from federal alignment.

party_parents_added.name: United Progressive Kinabalu Organisation
party_parents_added.description: A component of Gabungan Rakyat Sabah (GRS), admitted on 18 June 2026.

methodology: Commitments, documented activities and limited delivery reports are distinct. Evidence-only records have no invented earlier promise. Achieved covers the described handover, programme session or launch only. Shared agency responsibility, historical dates, count units, source limitations and missing follow-up evidence are explicit. No claim of exhaustive research is made.
